title: Tiny, cute magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x='62' y='62' width='26' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='#FFB74D' transform='rotate(45 62 62)'/>
  <rect x='68' y='68' width='22' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='#FFA726' transform='rotate(45 68 68)'/>
  <!-- Handle end cap -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='84' r='7' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='82' r='3' fill='#FFCC80'/>
  <!-- Lens rim -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='22' fill='#64B5F6'/>
  <!-- Lens rim highlight -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='20' fill='#42A5F5'/>
  <!-- Glass -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='17' fill='#E1F5FE'/>
  <!-- Glass tint edge -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Glass shine -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='31' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-35 31 31)'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Rim top highlight -->
  <path d='M 20 32 A 22 22 0 0 1 44 17' fill='none' stroke='#BBDEFB' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tiny cute eye reflection in the glass -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='36' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#1E88E5' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- Small sparkle -->
  <path d='M 30 28 L 31.5 31 L 34.5 32 L 31.5 33 L 30 36 L 28.5 33 L 25.5 32 L 28.5 31 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
</svg>
